description:
Reid RB250 Mini 16" eBike | Electric mini bike
Compact, distinctive and built for fun, the RB250 Mini combines a unique moto-inspired design with practical electric assistance for shorter journeys.
The Reid RB250 Mini 16" is a compact electric bike designed for teenagers and adults looking for something a little different. Inspired by the popular moto-style eBike trend, it pairs a distinctive look with an easy-to-use setup for everyday rides and shorter journeys.
Its sturdy steel frame features an integrated bench seat and compact 16" wheels, creating a distinctive profile with a comfortable riding position. Wide 16 x 3.0" tyres and a stable wheelbase help provide a smooth, confident ride, while simple single-speed gearing keeps things straightforward.
A 250W motor with 350W peak power provides electric assistance up to 15.5mph, supported by a 36V 13Ah (468Wh) battery. With an approximate range of up to 50 miles (80km), depending on terrain and riding style, the RB250 Mini offers plenty of support for shorter everyday trips.
Mechanical disc brakes provide dependable stopping power, while integrated front and rear LED lights help improve visibility. Front and rear mudguards and a kickstand add everyday practicality, making the RB250 Mini ready for a variety of short rides.
Weighing approximately 25kg, the RB250 Mini combines moto-inspired styling, a compact frame and easy electric assistance in a distinctive package for riders looking for an alternative to a conventional electric bike.
The RB250 Mini 16" eBike is ideal for:

Teenagers and adults, with a distinctive compact design and integrated bench seat

Shorter everyday journeys, supported by a 250W motor and 468Wh battery

Longer rides, with an approximate range of up to 50 miles (80km), depending on riding conditions

Simple, easy riding, with straightforward single-speed gearing

A distinctive moto-inspired look, with wide tyres and a unique frame design

Confident stopping, with mechanical disc brakes

Everyday practicality, with integrated LED lights, mudguards and a kickstand

components.description: Mechanical disc brake with motor cut-off levers, 160mm rotors
Jiabo 36V 250W (350W peak power) rear hub motor, 40nm torque
Moto riser bar, 600mm wide, 250mm rise, 22.2mm clamp
Integrated alloy nutted front, 350w rear hub motor
